title: Demo catalog manifest (demo.json)
description: Describes one demo in the catalog. Place this file at the root of the demo folder and at the root of its archive. Unknown fields are allowed and preserved.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version. Only 1 is supported.

id.description: Demo ID and folder name. Optional on import; derived from the archive folder name or title when absent. Must match the folder name when present.

title.description: Display title shown in the catalog.

description.description: Short summary shown on catalog cards and used for search.

tags.description: Search tags. Duplicates (ignoring case) are removed.

updated.description: Optional last-updated date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the newest file modification date.

readme.description: Relative path of the Markdown file shown on the demo page.
